external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Are what we believe in! At Nando’s, we’re working hard to be consciously inclusive about the people we hire. We’ve partnered with Yellow Ribbon, a rehabilitation charity, to work with ex-offenders in Singapore. We help their re-entry into society with career opportunities that make sure their past doesn’t affect their future. We’ve been hiring from Yellow Ribbon since 2014, with people working their way up from Nandoca all the way, in some cases, to restaurant manager.

internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Project Generation in the USA, for example, unites all Nando’s Washington restaurants in a mission to remove many of the barriers to employment some young people face. The project helps candidates face issues such as access to transport, childcare, or a gap on their cv, and looks to hire Nandocas for one key attribute: a positive attitude.
